fixtures.preview: A Sunday 2pm Roses clash at Elland Road, with Michael Carrick's injury-hit United reportedly on one Premier League win this season.
talking_points: Noussair Mazraoui has resumed training and Carrick says he could be involved at Elland Road.
Luke Shaw and Kobbie Mainoo both suffered fresh setbacks against Spurs and remain doubtful.
Benjamin Sesko, Patrick Dorgu and Manuel Ugarte are listed as unavailable.
Matthijs de Ligt returned to the bench against Atlético and is being eased back, so a start looks unlikely.

fixtures.preview: United's first competitive meeting with Cesc Fàbregas's Como, a matchday 3 trip to Lake Como.
A Sunday home game against Bournemouth, moved from Saturday for UK TV.
A lunchtime trip to Stamford Bridge with a 12:30pm UK start.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford.
A Sunday-afternoon home game against Adelaide United, played as a doubleheader with the women's match against Melbourne City at 5:45pm.
A 5pm Halloween game at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's official home opener.
A Friday-night home game against the Mariners.
An away trip to Brisbane Roar at Kayo Stadium in matchweek 5.
